title: Beautyworld Osaka draws record 37,561 visitors, highlights sleep wellness
summary: The beauty trade fair focusing on western Japan concluded its three-day run from 19-21 October 2026 at INTEX Osaka, welcoming a record 37,561 trade visitors, up 7.3% from the previous year. A total of 573 exhibitors from Japan and overseas showcased products and services across the aesthetic, hair, nail, eyelash, wellness and other beauty-related sectors, reflecting current industry trends.
